Action.description: One action of the ledger (contract §3). §12.4 adds optional fields; ignore what you do not know.

plan.description: §12.4: what the action would do, rendered at request time
plan.title: Plan

plan_sha256.description: §12.4: fingerprint the approval is bound to
plan_sha256.title: Plan Sha256

state.description: requested | awaiting_approval | accepted | dispatched | succeeded | failed | cancelled | expired | outcome_unknown
state.title: State

type.description: app.install | app.remove | app.start | app.stop | app.restart | app.update | app.configure | app.delete_data (more in §12.5)
type.title: Type

Action.title: Action

AppCredentials.description: GET /v1/apps/{id}/credentials: the app's generated login. Owner only, audited, never cached.
AppCredentials.title: AppCredentials

AppLinks.description: §9.3 metadata.links. Only absolute http(s) URLs are passed through; anything else is null.
AppLinks.title: AppLinks

AuditVerify.description: GET /v1/audit/verify (§12.16). `last_checkpoint` stays null until signed checkpoints ship (H-10).
AuditVerify.title: AuditVerify

CatalogApp.description: One GET /v1/apps entry: the §3 fields plus links, tier and scan (§11.4).

data_kept.description: True when the app was removed but its data volumes were kept (reinstall picks them up; app.delete_data erases them)
data_kept.title: Data Kept

scan.description: Last scan, or null when apps/<id>/scan.json is missing or invalid. Install is refused (409 stale_precondition) unless result is pass and scanned_at is at most 7 days old

status.description: not_installed | installing | installed | stopped | starting | stopping | restarting | updating | configuring | removing | deleting_data | failed | unknown
status.title: Status

tier.description: Set by the app CI gate (§9.4); null when the manifest has none yet
tier.title: Tier

CatalogApp.title: CatalogApp

ErrorBody.description: The section 3 error envelope, published in /openapi.json.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

Node.description: One node: the §2 heartbeat plus the gateway's `status` and `last_seen`. More fields may appear.

last_seen.description: RFC 3339 time the gateway last received a heartbeat
last_seen.title: Last Seen

Node.title: Node

PlanPreview.description: GET /v1/apps/{id}/plan and POST /v1/plans (contract §12.4): what an action would do. Files nothing.

plan.description: summary, objects, volumes, warnings: what the approval card shows
plan.title: Plan

plan_sha256.description: send this with the request and the approval; a different plan is refused
plan_sha256.title: Plan Sha256

policy_verdict.description: needs_approval | refused (the app is in a state this action cannot start from)
policy_verdict.title: Policy Verdict

reason.description: why the verdict is refused; null otherwise
reason.title: Reason

PlanPreview.title: PlanPreview

PlanRequest.description: POST /v1/plans (contract §12.4): the same type and params as a request, nothing is filed.
PlanRequest.title: PlanRequest

PrincipalRef.description:
{id, kind, role} of contract §3; kind and role may gain values (§12.1). An action's
`requested_by` carries only {id, kind} (§12.4), so role is optional.
PrincipalRef.title: PrincipalRef

ScanSummary.description: §11.1 apps/<id>/scan.json, reduced to what the catalog shows.

scanned_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the last scan
scanned_at.title: Scanned At

ScanSummary.title: ScanSummary

onemind_core__routers__actions__ApproveB.description: §12.4: optional approve body. `webauthn` is the passkey assertion over approve-options' challenge.
onemind_core__routers__actions__ApproveB.title: ApproveBody

onemind_core__routers__files__ApproveBod.description: §12.4: the plan the approver was shown, and the passkey assertion once step-up exists.
onemind_core__routers__files__ApproveBod.title: ApproveBody

post.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per request: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. Read tools (get_instance, list_nodes, get_node, list_apps, get_app, list_actions, get_action, search_audit), one request-only tool (request_action) and onemind:// resources. No approve tool. Notifications get 202; over the per-agent message limit, 429.
